subpages.text: vCIO Vartek provides schools with access to the expertise of a CIO (Chief Information Officer) without the need to hire one full-time. Our vCIO can oversee the overall technology direction of your school, and manage its IT vendors and service provider relationships. Our vCIO can provide a range of IT leadership and strategic planning services: Developing and implementing IT plans and budgets Identifying and mitigating IT risks Providing guidance on technology-related business decisions. Audit: Analysis of business practices and existing technology to understand how the school uses IT Outlines how IT is used on a daily basis Guidance on strategic IT investments and overall budgeting Creation of a 3-year IT plan focused on adopting cost-effective technology to streamline operations Planning for technology refreshes and strategies in the long-term to maximize IT’s impact on business operations Regular reviews of the IT plan to uncover/discover new solutions to improve productivity and streamline operations (unlikely to be valued) Looking for professional IT management and direction? Our vCIO can offer specialized skills and experience that may not be available in-house, and it can provide a valuable external perspective on your school’s technology needs and goals. Varteks vCIO can help you improve your IT processes and drive better outcomes.
